content.short: Theta Network provides cutting-edge infrastructure for layer 1 blockchains (l1s), empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Theta Network is a purpose-built blockchain for decentralized video and content delivery, powering Web3 entertainment. As a prominent player in the Blockchains space, Theta Network specializes in delivering high-quality layer 1 blockchains (l1s) infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Ethereum, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, Theta Network focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
content.meta: Theta Network provides innovative layer 1 blockchains (l1s) tools for the Blockchains space. Discover Theta Network and other decentralized applications on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
